reviews.author: Dillon Smith
reviews.text: Had a shift knob break on me heading to NC and found this shop to be around where I broke down. Owner and employees were extremely nice and quick to fix it.

reviews.author: Vance Ferrigno
reviews.text: I purchased a set of tires a couple of years ago and have needed a plug for a nail in the tire twice now and they are quick to help without charging me. As I drive a lot for work, I had them inspect the tread and are honest telling me I still had plenty of life in the current set. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Shelli Wheeler
reviews.text: They were extremely nice and professional from start to finish. They helped me by adding air in all four of my tires, just so I could get back home to Atlanta safely. At the end, he didn’t even charge me at all, which really shows just how nice they are! They turned a stressful situation around for me and I am so grateful I pulled in for their help. If I lived closer, I would absolutely trust them to take care of any of my cars! Highly recommend them to anyone!!!

reviews.author: John Moffatt
reviews.text: Fantastic service, A+ workmanship, quality shop. Three AC shops could not find my issue, Les and the team at Allen's did the detective work, took the time, and found the issue. I'm not going anywhere else after this experience... Are they busy... yes.. but isn't that a good sign?

reviews.author: Raymond Sharp
reviews.text: If you've ever been put into the road side auto malfunction, or break down, you know how important it is to find a mechanic that knows what there doing and one that is honest with you. I was put in that situation yesterday morning while pulling my camper back home. My Ram 2500 6.7l Diesel began losing power to the point of just plain stopping with my foot to the floor. Looked for local auto mechanics nearby and Allan's popped up. I read the reviews and that convinced me to try and get there. I babied my truck the 8 miles in the other direction hoping to make it. I got there 10 mins before they opened, Les was there and jumped right into helping me. Les diagnosed the code and made some adjustments to the truck to correct the reGen of the exhaust. My exhaust was clogging up and robbing the engine of power. The fee was extremely fair and he had me out of there within an hour. I'm home in Pennsylvania now and the truck ran better than it had in years. I can't thank you enough Les, your the true deal.. Ray sharp

reviews.author: Nicholas Serino
reviews.text: My truck was overheating after a 2000 mile trek across the country. With fears of the worst, Allan’s shop took care of me with honest work & diagnostics. It’s good to know there’s business owners & staff like this in the area, makes relocating an easy transition. This is the first review I’ve ever written about anything, which is a testament to the impression I was left with.

reviews.author: Danielle Britt
reviews.text: Excellent customer service and they are active members of National Write your Congressman.. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Gary Fallon
reviews.text: Always makes me feel like a priority and does the job as it should be - no short cuts - just solid and complete work!

reviews.author: Ruth hodges
reviews.text: This the first time I've ever left a bad review . Normally I walk away from a loss but wow! He messed our work trucks up bad. After trying get in touch with him for a week finally took to another mechanic said the valve cover was folded and cut . We Also spent almost 1000$ on other truck we are having to get redone elswhere. Being a small business owner having two trucks down for a week has been devastating!

reviews.author: Felix Turner
reviews.text: Top notch, A-1 mechanic, one of the best there is! I have zero complaints. I've known Les for decades, and I wouldn't recommend anyone else but him!

reviews.author: Leeanna
reviews.text: The Experience of the mechanics comes through!! They are very knowledgeable and precise. I'll be taking all of my vehicles there for repairs! I was very happy with my service!

reviews.author: Cedric Hinton
reviews.text: Allan's Automotive does great work at a fair price. Also the staff was courteous and professional. I would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Jeff Davis
reviews.text: Les knows his stuff! The most reasonably priced and honest mechanic I've ever done business with. He's done several projects for me over the years and I've been thrilled with his work every time.

reviews.author: Gina Polston
reviews.text: Les helped me so much!!! I took my car to a dealership and they tried to sell me all kinds of unnecessary work. I took it to Allen's and he shot me straight, saved me $2700 according to the quote from the dealership!! I will definitely be returning.

reviews.author: Stacey Guyton
reviews.text: My bus caught a flat tire while I was transporting 8 passengers. My tire got plugged and we were sent on our way. Thank you Allans Automotive for your Godly service.

reviews.author: Paul D
reviews.text: Good guys. Best diesel engine mechanic in the area. They fixed my 7.3 oil pressure issue. They will find and resolve your diesel engine problem.

reviews.author: Joe Gilreath
reviews.text: Great service! Excellent Ford diesel mechanic! Highly recommend Allen's automotive for any of your truck/car repair needs.

reviews.author: Ben Brower
reviews.text: Great shop- Les and Travis are helpful and know how to get repairs done right and reasonable ! Did my diesel bullet proofing several years ago and still running great !

reviews.author: dave burnett
reviews.text: Les has always been able to find issues with my truck that no one else has been able to figure out. He is very fair and knowledgeable.

reviews.author: Ray VanDerVelde
reviews.text: Les was great. We were traveling through the area and needed some fuel pump help. Les got us back on the road in no time at a price we could afford. Thanks Les.

reviews.author: Drop-A-Top Tree Service
reviews.text: These guys are expert diesel mechanics and know their stuff. I highly recommend them for all of your diesel truck repairs.

reviews.author: Charlie Nimitz
reviews.text: My work van lost a pulley and broke the serpentine belt on my commute. They were able to fit me in spur of the moment and got me back on the road within an hour.

reviews.author: Gary Rottier
reviews.text: Best mechanic around. Full of integrity and knowledge. Sometimes there may be a wait due to his great reputation in the area.

reviews.author: Philip Lancelot
reviews.text: Very knowledgable mechanics. More than willing to help me with my issues while on the road at a late hour. Life saver. Thanks again.
